objective: Let the composer attach one sports-data link (a completed game, a player's played line in one game, or a player's career in one scope) through pickers built on the existing events/ routes, with a summary of the attachment, Undo and Remove before publishing, a documented /compose address that opens it pre-filled, and the #/$ mention dropdown removed.
acceptance_criteria: On /compose with no reply context, an 'Attach stats' control opens a picker with three choices: Game result, Player's game, Player career. It is absent from InlineComposer (the thread's reply box) and from /compose?reply_to=<id>.

Game result: the user narrows by team and season (GET /events/teams, /events/seasons, /events/games?team_id&season); a game whose home and away scores are both 0 is not offered; choosing one attaches {type: 'game_final', ref_id: <game id>}.

Player's game: after choosing a game the same way, the picker lists that game's box-score players from GET /events/games/{id} with their line_id; did-not-play players are not offered; choosing one attaches {type: 'player_game', ref_id: <line_id>}.

Player career: the user searches players by name (GET /events/players?q=), chooses one, then a scope, Regular season or Playoffs, from GET /events/players/{id}; a scope whose career line has games_played 0 is not offered; choosing attaches {type: 'player_career', ref_id: <player id>, scope}.

An attached link shows a summary in the composer naming what it is (teams, score and date; player, team, opponent, date and points; player, scope and games played), with Remove (clears it) and Undo (restores the draft from before the last attach or replace, via DraftSnapshot); attaching again replaces the link.

Post sends data_link exactly as attached (no scope key except for player_career) alongside text and media_ids; a draft with only a link and no text or image cannot be posted; on /compose?repost_of=<id> a link can be attached and the post needs text.

A 422 whose detail is one of POSTS-005's machine codes (link_target_not_found, game_not_completed, player_did_not_play, no_games_in_scope, data_link_on_reply, data_link_needs_quote_text) keeps the draft and its attachment and shows a specific message for it; any other failure keeps the existing generic message.

/compose?link=game_final&ref=<game id>, /compose?link=player_game&ref=<line_id>&game=<game id> and /compose?link=player_career&ref=<player id>&scope=regular|playoffs open the composer with that link attached and its summary shown; a missing, malformed or unknown parameter set, a line not in that game's box score, a DNP line, an incomplete game or a scope with no games opens it with no attachment and an inline note; the parsing is one exported function, validated at the boundary like postIdIn.

The #/$ mention dropdown is gone: MentionAutocomplete, mentions.ts, the mention-inserted event and the Undo mention control are deleted, typing # or $ fetches nothing, and a typed #GameId123 is sent as plain text; the composer still makes no request on mount.
ComposeMediator stays the only wiring between text box, attachment picker and media widget; Draft gains the link; PostBuilder and the quick-post Prototype clone handle it without sharing objects.

Every existing frontend test passes except those pinning the removed dropdown, which the test commit deletes or rewrites and names in its message; typecheck, lint and build pass; 0x08-frontend.md and FrontendUI/components.md describe the picker and the summary.

Browser rows (vite preview against backend-dev with seeded data, signed in, light and dark, 360 and 1280 wide): attach each of the three types and post it, the post appears in the feed; Remove and Undo; a DNP player and a 0-0 game are not offered; a pre-filled /compose address shows its summary; keyboard-only: the picker opens, every choice is reachable, focus returns to Attach stats on close.
